overview: Burrow Warrens is the subterranean hive beneath Grimling Forest, where Acrylia corruption mutates burrow creatures and destabilizes the forest.
history: Burrow creatures tunneled into Acrylia veins and became corrupted.
Collapsed tunnels formed crystal chambers beneath the forest.
Grimling shamans attempted to use the Warrens for ritual empowerment.
Seru scouts mapped the upper tunnels but never reached the hive core.
A corrupted hive queen emerged from the deepest Acrylia chamber.
hooks: A new hive queen begins forming.
Grimlings attempt to weaponize burrow mutants.
Seru scouts disappear in the lower tunnels.
